admissibility: Not currently proposed acceptable for installation: unknown component identity prevents bounded advisory/notice review. Only a separately empowered human policy owner may decide whether a distinct bounded native-identity exception is admissible; provenance acceptance cannot cover it implicitly.
proposed_validity: No acceptance period until admissibility and bounded risk are established; no blanket unknown-version waiver
revocation_triggers: Different filename, hash, version, platform, ABI or runtime identity
Material new vulnerability, suspected tampering or publisher compromise
Trust-policy, isolation, dependency/SBOM or intended-use change
Expiry, loss of approver authority, withdrawn evidence or unmet compensating control
